u0: Progress: not carrying the box and no fall pending; this is the neutral start state. Next objective: locate and pick up the purple box to begin carrying it, while keeping in mind that a box fall from unheld hands is impossible. Avoid standing on the exit without the box, since that would end the episode without meeting the holding requirement.
u1: Progress: the box just fell from your hands (or you are still in the fall-handling state); hands are empty and the box is on the floor nearby. Next objective: on your very next move, pick the box back up. A successful pickup records a reward and moves you into the post-recovery carried state; do not detour, drop, or head for the exit before recovering it.
u2: Progress: you are carrying the box and have not just recovered it from a fall; this is the steady carrying state. Next objective: continue toward the exit while holding the box—turning and moving forward as needed—and avoid any event that makes the box fall. If the box falls, you will switch into the fall-handling state and must recover it immediately.
u3: Progress: you successfully picked the box back up after a fall; this is the recovered-carrying state. Next objective: head straight for the exit with the box in hand. If the box falls again, return to the fall-handling state and recover it on the next move; otherwise keep carrying the box until you step onto the exit.
u4: Progress: terminal success—you reached the exit while holding the box. No further objective; the task is complete.
